qlora.exposure: Exact sampled Legacy source IDs unavailable in removed cohort cache; incomplete models excluded, never presumed unexposed

dora.exposure: Exact sampled Legacy source IDs unavailable in removed cohort cache; incomplete models excluded, never presumed unexposed

categories: P primary; V exploratory; T never evaluated
sample_rule: Ascending SHA256(1027:hsc_object_id); no z or predictions in sampling; n=0 means entire category
unchanged_selection: Checkpoints selected on archived HSC validation CE only; no new model/preprocessing/calibration selection using paired labels
label_rule: Conservative pre-prediction agreement <=1e-6*(1+abs(z_Iron)); exclude ambiguous differences, do not adjudicate by prediction error; retain original HSC native HDF labels for all cells

P.merge_rule: Accumulate adjacent bins left-to-right until >=40; merge final small tail backward
P.standardization: Equal weight for each nonempty merged spec-z bin; macro-average within-bin metrics, including NMAD (not pooled weighted NMAD)

V.merge_rule: Accumulate adjacent bins left-to-right until >=40; merge final small tail backward
V.standardization: Equal weight for each nonempty merged spec-z bin; macro-average within-bin metrics, including NMAD (not pooled weighted NMAD)

support.fit: HSC source training photometry only; no target labels
support.rule: Both HSC and Legacy must have valid common g/r/z and all 11 transformed coordinates within HSC training marginal 0.5–99.5 percentiles
support.caveat: Simple marginal optical-support diagnostic, not a density estimate or bandpass matching; strict joint cuts may leave few objects

bootstrap.conditional: Existing frozen checkpoints; no training-seed uncertainty

source_test_policy: Original HSC test objects were previously evaluated in completed training reports; now permitted for this predeclared frozen-model matched observation comparison, with no tuning or checkpoint selection. Not a never-inspected external sample.
comparisons: HSC vs Legacy within each frozen model; A/B/C penalties on identical IDs; empty Legacy-trained rows, no bidirectional claim
